title: UC-02 · Zone failure of the primary
subtitle: Force the AG over to the synchronous secondary in the other zone, then bring the failed node back

clocks.label: Outage clock
clocks.explain: From the failure of {primaryDomain} to the application's first commit on {secondary}

clocks.label: Failback interruption
clocks.explain: From the AG going offline on {secondary} to the application's first commit back on {primary}

phases.label: Pre-check
phases.explain: Checking both nodes are up, {secondary} is SYNCHRONOUS and every database SYNCHRONIZED

phases.label: Start application
phases.explain: An application writer commits a ledger row every 0.2 s on {primary} ({primaryDomain})

phases.label: Warm-up
phases.explain: Normal operation: every commit is hardened on {secondary} ({secondaryDomain}) before it is acknowledged

phases.label: Zone failure
phases.explain: {primary} is powered off hard - no shutdown, like losing {primaryDomain}

phases.label: Detection
phases.explain: {secondary} notices it has lost the primary; the application's commits fail

phases.label: Forced failover
phases.explain: Promoting {secondary}: it already holds every acknowledged commit (synchronous)

phases.label: App reconnects
phases.explain: The application retries and commits on {secondary} by itself - this stops the outage clock

phases.label: Verify
phases.explain: Every commit acknowledged before the failure is in the ledger of {secondary}

phases.label: Fence old primary
phases.explain: Blocking {primary} on the network first: it may boot believing it is still primary

phases.label: Node back
phases.explain: Starting {primary}

phases.label: Inspect
phases.explain: Rows only {primary} has: commits whose acknowledgement never reached the application

phases.label: Demote
phases.explain: {primary} becomes a secondary of {secondary}

phases.label: Resynchronize
phases.explain: {primary} catches up from {secondary} until SYNCHRONIZED

phases.label: Lift fence
phases.explain: {primary} is a healthy secondary again - clients may connect

phases.label: Synchronize
phases.explain: Waiting until every database is SYNCHRONIZED on {primary}

phases.label: AG offline
phases.explain: Taking the AG offline on {secondary}

phases.label: Promote
phases.explain: {primary} becomes primary again

phases.label: Demote
phases.explain: {secondary} goes back to secondary

phases.label: App reconnects
phases.explain: The application commits on {primary} again

phases.label: Verify
phases.explain: Nothing lost, {secondary} SYNCHRONIZED

metrics.label: Lost transactions (RPO)
metrics.explain: Commits acknowledged before the failure that are missing on {secondary}

metrics.label: Throughput
metrics.explain: Commits the application gets acknowledged per second, now

metrics.label: Rows only on the old primary
metrics.explain: Committed on {primary} but never acknowledged (in flight at the failure) - discarded

charts.label: Application throughput
charts.explain: Drops to 0 at the failure, resumes when {secondary} is promoted

charts.label: Failed attempts
charts.explain: Errors the application retries while there is no primary

charts.label: Slowest commit
charts.explain: Synchronous commit: each commit waits for the secondary

charts.label: Redo queue (secondary)
charts.explain: Grows while {primary} catches up after the reinstate

criteria.label: {secondary} primary, databases online, application writing to it
RTO measured from the application's side
The application reconnected to {secondary} by itself
Old primary fenced before power-on (no split-brain)
